description: The user wrote in a choice point: its four texts as they now stand. A new id starts a new choice point on the given day; for one already kept the day is ignored.

situation.description: The situation: what happened, where and with whom.

thoughts.description: The thoughts and feelings the situation brought.

away.description: What the user did or would do when hooked: a move away from what matters.

towards.description: What the user did or would do when unhooked: a move towards what matters.

finished.description: The lines the user has just finished and moved on from, for Jev to check: the line left by Enter or by moving the cursor to another line, every line of a box that lost focus, or every line of a sheet that folded. Absent or empty when the save is only typing.

field.description: The box the line is in.
